# Sourcefolio

> Local-first evidence archive and personal knowledge system for saved TikTok videos, slideshows and other media.

Evidence Vault: a local-first system that turns saved TikTok videos, slideshows and other sources into an archive of evidence, personal context and decision history. Python 3.12+, pydantic v2, a SQLite control plane and a ports-and-adapters modular monolith.

This file follows the llms.txt convention: a short, LLM-friendly index of the project.

## Docs

- [Documentation](https://github.com/WhiteBite/Sourcefolio/tree/main/docs): setup, configuration and scoring reference
- [Homepage](https://github.com/WhiteBite/Sourcefolio#readme): project landing page
- [Issues](https://github.com/WhiteBite/Sourcefolio/issues): roadmap and known gaps
- [README.md](./README.md): install, run and test instructions

## Key facts

- Install: `python -m pip install -e '.[dev]'`
- Run: `evidence-vault --help`
- Test: `pytest`
- Use cases: Archive saved TikTok videos, slideshows and collections as immutable, content-addressed captures; Extract OCR text from slides and search it lexically with provenance; Build query-driven evidence packs with ranked sources, snippets and typed locators; Generate an Obsidian vault with source cards, collection indexes and triage dashboards; Match saved content against your own projects and keep a decision history

## Distribution tracking

- Ledger: `.discoverability/submissions.json`, committed campaign state with schema `rdk-distribution/1`.
- `rdk track` prints the live status (`--json` for the canonical object); `--adopt` pulls pre-ledger rdk/* PRs in, `--sync` rewrites recorded statuses from live probes, `--mark <target> --status <status>` overrides one row.
- Every ledger write requires the guard chain `--apply --ack <ACK> --reason "<why>" --plan-digest <DIGEST>` (the digest of the dry-run preview).
- Non-PR channels report live presence by probe: `crawl`, `http-search` and `registry-read`; PR channels report state via `gh`.
